title: Caching
subtitle: Identical non-streaming chat requests from the same key are answered from the cache for the configured time.
ttlHint: 0 turns the cache off. Clients skip the cache with the x-hub-bypass-cache header or "cache": false.

store.title: Response cache
store.description: Responses are stored per key, model, and request body. Hits are free for the key and logged as cache hits.
store.backend: {backend, select, redis {Redis, shared} memory {In memory} other {Redis unreachable}}
store.backendHint: {backend, select, redis {All app instances share the cache, and it survives restarts. Responses stay in Redis until they expire.} memory {Each app process keeps its own cache, which is emptied on restart. Set REDIS_URL to share it.} other {REDIS_URL is set, but Redis does not answer. Each app process uses its own memory cache until Redis is back.}}

semantic.title: Semantic matching
semantic.description: Answers a request from the cache when only the last user message differs and means nearly the same. System prompt, earlier messages, model, and parameters must still match exactly.
semantic.enabledHint: {ready, select, true {Every cache miss first embeds the last user message. That adds latency and embedding cost.} other {Choose an embedding model first.}}
semantic.modelHint: Embeddings run on this alias with the calling key's routing rules and are billed to that key. Keys that may not use this model only get exact matches.
semantic.thresholdHint: Minimum cosine similarity. Lower values answer more requests but can return an answer to a different question.

stats.title: Cache statistics
stats.hint: Counts cacheable requests across all keys. Net savings are the cost of the original responses served again from the cache, minus the embedding cost of semantic lookups.
